description: This is a PHP source file defining a migration script for a Human Resource Management system (OrangeHRM). It contains methods to modify the database schema and configuration related to version 5.0.0 beta, including renaming columns, creating tables, updating menu items, and configuring email templates and report display fields.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Defines a database migration for OrangeHRM version 5.0.0 beta, including schema updates, configuration changes, and email template adjustments.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes schema and configuration updates for the migration, such as renaming columns, creating new tables, updating menu items, and configuring email templates.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version identifier of this migration ('5.0-beta').

methods.name: updateHomePage
methods.description: Updates the home page URL for a specified user role.

methods.name: getEmailIdByName
methods.description: Retrieves the email ID associated with a given email name, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: updateEmailProcessorClassByEmailName
methods.description: Updates the class responsible for processing a specific type of email.

methods.name: updateEmailTemplateSubjectAndBodyByEmailNameAndRecipientRole
methods.description: Updates the subject and body templates of an email for a specific email name and recipient role.

methods.name: getReportDisplayGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a report display group by its name, with caching.

methods.name: updateReportDisplayFieldByGroup
methods.description: Updates the class_name of display fields belonging to a specific report display group.

methods.name: updateReportFilterFieldByFieldName
methods.description: Updates the class_name of a report filter field identified by field name.

methods.name: renameReportDisplayFieldAlias
methods.description: Renames the field alias for report display fields.

methods.name: renameSelectedReportFilterFieldWhereCondition
methods.description: Renames the where_condition value for selected report filter fields.

methods.name: updateReportDisplayFieldByFieldAlias
methods.description: Updates the class_name of a report display field identified by its alias.

methods.name: updateScreenModuleId
methods.description: Updates the module ID associated with a specific screen by action URL and name.

methods.name: updateMenuItemIconNames
methods.description: Updates the icon name in the menu item additional parameters for a given menu title.
